correctness.rationale: All 2024 candidate vertex triples are evaluated exactly in the cubic field to reconstruct 32 triangular and 6 square facets and 60 edges; exhaustive great-circle intersection and local wedge enumeration establishes 482 chambers with side counts 12–18. All 1824 corner incidences are assigned by exact determinant signs, and Girard’s formula yields the displayed seven Haar probability expressions. Rational isolating interval makes each algebraic sign rigorous; exact source code replayed. Independent Gaussian-normal diagnostics agree and are not relied upon as proof.
